latestVersion.changelog:
Photo to Video with Music — initial release

- Instantly turn your photos and an audio track into a ready-to-share 1080p MP4 video.
- Upload images (JPG, PNG, HEIC) and audio (MP3) up to 200MB; supports batch uploads and cloud rendering on remote GPU.
- No editing software required — simple chat instructions handle slideshow creation, background music, and export.
- Designed for fast workflows: typical processing time is 30–90 seconds; export with a single request.
- Built-in session management, credit handling, export pipeline, and clear error reporting.
- Ideal for social creators and everyday users seeking fast, AI-powered video creation from photos.
